description: Defines classes and structures related to display capture arguments in the Android GUI framework, including Parcelable implementations and data members for capture configuration.

classes.name: CaptureArgs
classes.description: Parcelable structure holding parameters for capturing display content, including pixel format, crop rectangle, scale, security options, and dataspace.

classes.name: DisplayCaptureArgs
classes.description: Derived from CaptureArgs, adds display token, dimensions, and transform flag for specific display capture configuration.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the object into a Parcel for IPC or storage.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a Parcel.
